title: Lakshadweep PM-JAY health assurance Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance access for eligible Lakshadweep residents through the applicable PM-JAY/UT health framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current PM-JAY/UT beneficiary rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Lakshadweep PM-JAY health assurance.
